title: Myrna Hansen hypnotic regression and underground facility abduction

tellings.quote: the woman MNA Hansen that she he had coming to his house in the 80s talking about she was talking about being abducted and going to this underground facility

plain: Around 1980 near Albuquerque, New Mexico, a woman named Myrna Hansen said she had been abducted and taken to an underground facility. Her memories came out under hypnosis, with the psychologist Leo Sprinkle. The researcher Greg Bishop tells it as part of the story of Paul Bennewitz, an Albuquerque businessman she came to visit at his house to talk about her abduction, and in Bishop's telling her account fed the idea of hidden underground bases.
